name: Lingbi stone (black limestone, Lingbi County, Anhui)

diffuseAlbedo.note: A first colour for Lingbi stone (black limestone, Lingbi County, Anhui): no measured colour was read: a first value read from trade and museum photographs of the named material.

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: optics.specularF0 (0.0533, calcite grains in random orientations)
refractiveIndex.derivation: n = (1 + sqrt(F0)) / (1 - sqrt(F0)), the index whose normal-incidence reflectance is the record's F0

porosity.note: A first open porosity for the rock type; no measurement of this stone was read.

wettingDepth.note: The depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.source: Li L., Zhao J., Li J., Guo J. (2026) 'Provenance study of Eastern Zhou Dynasty (770-256 BC) stone chimes excavated from the Chu territory, China', Frontiers in Earth Science 14:1812060, doi:10.3389/feart.2026.1812060: Lingbi samples Lbs01 0.02-0.1 mm, Lbs02 0.01-0.05 mm, Lbs03 0.01-0.1 mm, 'calcite grains in mosaic contact, with minimal mineral impurities', https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/earth-science/articles/10.3389/feart.2026.1812060/full
grain.note: Verified. The ranges and the mosaic calcite texture are as stated. I did not confirm the Qingyunshan locality detail, so the citation names the samples by their Lbs labels only.
grain.derivation: Geometric mean of the combined measured range: sqrt(0.01 mm x 0.1 mm) = 0.0316 mm

bed.note: The coarsest structure the face shows: its bedding, veining or banding.

bedAspect.note: How much longer the structure runs along its bedding than across it.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
